description: List inventory items with optional filters. For an exact SKU identity question, provide the exact value in search and set include_listing_identity=true to resolve Amazon seller SKUs and return source listing identifiers such as ASIN and FNSKU.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Pass it with the same other inputs until has_more is false.

include_listing_identity.description: Set true only with an exact search value for a SKU identity question. Resolves an exact Amazon seller SKU even when it differs from the canonical SKU and returns listing source, ASIN, and FNSKU evidence.

needs_review.description: true: only items flagged for review; false: only items not flagged.

offset.description: Deprecated: rows to skip. Use cursor; it stays correct while rows change.

vendor_id.description: Only items whose primary supplier is this supplier id (from rr_list_suppliers).

name: rr_list_products
